verses.t: EVEN far and wide, O Varuṇa and Mitra, doth your grace extend. May I obtain your kind good-will.
From you, benignant Gods, may we gain fully food for sustenance. Such, O ye Rudras, my we be.
Guard us, O Rudras. with your guard save us, ye skilled to save, my we Subdue the Dasyus, we ourselves,
Or ne’er may we, O Wondrous Strong, enjoy another's solemn feast, Ourselves, our sons, or progeny.
